name: Veinwood Tree
description: A green-crowned tree of the Violet Strata whose bark and fruit carry violet sap.
role: The landmark tree of the Violet Strata; it shows how the mutagenic flora changed native growth.

artBrief.silhouette: Tall crown on a brown trunk; violet dots read even at 16×16.
artBrief.detail: Violet veins run up the trunk into the crown and swell into fruit.
distinctiveFeatures: violet fruit in a green crown
